text.p: NOTICE OF NOTE SALE
CITY OF APPLETON, WISCONSIN
OUTAGAMIE, WINNEBAGO AND CALUMET COUNTIES, WISCONSIN
GENERAL OBLIGATION PROMISSORY NOTES, SERIES 1997A
Bids will be received for the purchase of all but no part of the above Notes until 11:00 a.m., Central Time, on
August 20, 1997,
at the offices of the Budget Manager of the City and the City's Financial Advisor, Robert W. Baird & Co.
Incorporated, Public Finance Department, 777 East Wisconsin Avenue, Milwaukee, Wisconsin 53202, Attention: Ms. Megan
Vichich, Financial Analyst, Telephone: (414) 765-3827, Fax: (414) 298-7354. The Notes will be dated September 1, 1997, and will mature April 1, in the years and amounts as follows:
YearPrincipal Amount YearPrincipal Amount

Notes maturing on or after April 1, 2006 are subject to prior redemption at the option of the City on April 1, 2005 or on any date thereafter, in whole or in part, in such order of maturity as the City may select, at a price of par plus accrued interest to the date of redemption. Interest
on the Notes will be payable on April 1, 1998 and

semiannually thereafter on the first day of October and April. The proceeds of the Notes will be used to finance projects undertaken for public purposes, including, but not limited to, the construction of a municipal services
building and construction and improvements relating to sanitary sewers, sidewalks, streets, storm sewers, water mains and a water treatment plant. An approving legal
opinion will be furnished by Foley & Lardner of Milwaukee, Wisconsin. In order to assist bidders in complying with

S.E.C. Rule 15c2-12(b)(5), the City will undertake, pursuant to the resolution awarding the sale of the Notes and a Master Agreement on Continuing Disclosure, to provide annual reports and notices of certain events. A description of

this undertaking is set forth in the Official Statement. The purchaser's obligation to purchase the Notes will be conditioned upon its receiving the executed Master Agreement on Continuing Disclosure at or prior to delivery of the Notes. Bidders should be aware that the Official Terms of Offering and the bid form may contain additional bidding terms and information relative to the Notes. In the event of a variance between statements in this Notice of Note Sale, the bid form and/or said Official Terms of Offering,
the provisions of the Official Terms of Offering control.
Further information may be obtained from Robert W. Baird & Co. Incorporated at the address above or from the
undersigned.
Ms. Lisa Maertz, Budget Manager
City of Appleton
100 North Appleton Street
Appleton, Wisconsin 54913-2519
(From The Bond Buyer)
